explainer_content.short_definition: Modern psych and groove indie where hazy texture, looping rhythm, and sleek rock attitude drive discovery.
explainer_content.history_capsule: Tame Impala, Arctic Monkeys, MGMT, Glass Animals, Khruangbin, and related acts connect psych-pop color to indie-rock groove and streaming-era mood.
explainer_content.why_it_mattered: It explains why many modern rock listeners respond to feel, texture, and bassline before they respond to scene labels.
explainer_content.what_made_it_distinct: The route is less about aggression than about hypnotic propulsion and atmosphere.
